content: Just putting a reminder here that, once we're done with cslib#458, it'd be nice to have a quick review of this from @Haoxuan Yin or @Chris Henson.
@Haoxuan Yin we've merged cslib#458, @Chris Anto Fröschl needs to do some minor work on this and will ping us here then. Can you then have a look at this one maybe? :)
Thank you very much. I am happy to review this PR once it's ready.
I'd also be interested in taking a look once the merge conflicts are resolved.
@Haoxuan Yin @Chris Henson I've resolved the conflicts and added some additional comments regarding general structure. Let me know if anything is unclear.
@Chris Anto Fröschl I have done a review of this PR. Feel free to let me know about your thoughts.

@Haoxuan Yin thanks for the input. I still have to think about the sub directory approach for the alternative alpha-equivalences. It somewhat depends on how much we want to propagate a "default" alpha equivalence here. This would also change the correct location of *Property.lean files (since permutation based swaps wouldn't be part of the main narrative).
